backend/main.mo: Main backend canister defining trade, account, user profile, and performance metric types plus CRUD operations with authorization checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration stub that returns the old actor unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Evidence report linking a feature request to affected frontend file and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre‑generated summaries of multiple frontend files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind setup defining theme color variables and dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration wiring public and admin routes with layout and auth gates.
Admin layout with header, logout handling, and content container.
frontend/src/components/app/AppHeader.ts: Header component showing the branded wordmark linking to the homepage.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicFooter: Footer with trading disclaimer and copyright line including caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicLayout: Public layout with header, navigation bar, background texture, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/A: Dialog form for creating or editing managed accounts, handling form state and submit mutations.
Displays a table of accounts with options to add, edit, and delete using admin mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/C: Imports trades from a CSV file, validates rows, and submits each valid trade via mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/M: Loads and edits performance metrics, providing a form to update stored trading statistics.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/T: Dialog for adding or editing trades, managing form state and submit logic with create/update mutations.
Displays all trades in a table with edit, delete, and add-trade dialog actions, using React Query for data loading and mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/hooks/useAdm: Provides React Query mutation hooks for adding, updating, and deleting trades, accounts, and performance metrics with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/features/admin/pages/AdminD: Admin dashboard UI with tabs for managing trades, accounts, metrics, and CSV import.
frontend/src/features/admin/utils/csv.ts: Parses CSV trade data, validating fields and returning separate lists of valid trades and row-level errors.
frontend/src/features/analytics/componen: Renders an SVG equity curve with area shading and grid lines based on equity data points.
Displays monthly P&L as an SVG bar chart with positive and negative values visualized above or below a zero line.
Shows win/loss distribution using a donut chart and legend calculated from trade outcome counts.
frontend/src/features/analytics/pages/Pe: Loads trades and metrics to compute and display monthly P&L, win/loss stats, and an equity curve with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/features/analytics/utils/an: Provides utility functions to compute monthly PnL, win/loss stats, and equity curve from trade data.
frontend/src/features/auth/components/Ad: Component that restricts access to admin-only areas, handling loading, redirects, and access denial.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/useAdmi: Hook that checks Internet Identity authentication and queries whether the user is an admin.
frontend/src/features/auth/pages/AdminLo: Admin login page that triggers Internet Identity login and redirects authenticated admins to the dashboard.
frontend/src/features/auth/types.ts: Defines auth status types and the shape of the authentication state.
frontend/src/features/data/queries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching performance metrics, trades, and managed accounts from the backend actor.
frontend/src/features/public/components/: Renders a simple generated growth chart based on account balance using an SVG line and area plot.
UI component for selecting month, year, and result filters for trade lists.
Displays a table of trades with formatted fields, direction badges, and profit/loss coloring.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/HomeP: Home page showing performance metrics and summary cards, with meta tags for SEO.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Manag: Displays managed accounts with balance, risk profile, and growth charts, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Portf: Shows trade history with filters and a table, including loading skeletons and dynamic filtering logic.
frontend/src/features/public/utils/maski: Masks account names by keeping the first and last two characters visible and replacing the rest with asterisks.
frontend/src/features/seo/usePageMeta.ts: Updates document title and description meta tag on mount.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/GateScree: Provides a login form UI for the site gate with username, password, and error handling.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/SiteWideG: Wraps content with a login gate, validating credentials and controlling access flow.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/useSiteGa: Manages site gate state using sessionStorage with unlock, lock, and credential validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, login handling, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and color variables for light and dark themes, including chart palettes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read, store, and clear URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requests, and state information for build planning.
